Read 3D/4D NIfTI runs directly into MEDuSA time-by-voxel matrices

Source: R/nifti_ts.R
read_nifti_ts.Rd

Validates NIfTI spatial headers (`dim`, `pixdim`, units, and `sform`/`qform` affine) across runs, optional mask, and optional parcellation atlas before extracting selected voxels in C++ directly into `time x voxels` (`T x V`) numeric matrices without allocating full 4D double-precision R arrays.

The returned `"medusa_nifti_ts"` object supplies `$bold`, `$voxel_map`, `$parcel_ids`, and `$tr` ready to pass directly to [estimate_crossrun_hrf()], [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], [deconvolve_reglin()], and [write_nifti_ts()].

Usage

read_nifti_ts(
  niftis,
  mask = NULL,
  atlas = NULL,
  voxel_indices = NULL,
  atlas_subset = NULL,
  mask_threshold = 0,
  atlas_threshold = 0,
  tr = NULL,
  run_names = NULL,
  voxel_ids = NULL,
  id_style = c("ijk", "vnum"),
  orientation = c("time_by_voxel", "voxel_by_time"),
  drop = FALSE,
  ncpus = 1L
)

Arguments

niftis

Character vector of paths to 3D or 4D scalar NIfTI files (`.nii` or `.nii.gz`). Named vectors preserve run names in `$bold`.

mask

Optional path to a single-volume 3D NIfTI mask (or an in-memory `RNifti` image/array) retaining voxels strictly greater than `mask_threshold`.

atlas

Optional path to a single-volume 3D NIfTI parcellation/atlas (or in-memory `RNifti` image/array) retaining voxels strictly greater than `atlas_threshold` and populating `$voxel_map$atlas_value` and `$parcel_ids`.

voxel_indices

Optional numeric/integer vector of unique 1-based linear spatial indices to extract in exact order. When supplied, `mask` and `atlas` do not filter indices, though their values at `voxel_indices` are still recorded in `$voxel_map` if provided.

atlas_subset

Optional numeric/integer vector of `atlas` parcel values to retain when `voxel_indices` is `NULL` and `atlas` is supplied.

mask_threshold

Numeric threshold (`>` comparison) applied to `mask` when `voxel_indices` is `NULL`. Default `0`.

atlas_threshold

Numeric threshold (`>` comparison) applied to `atlas` when `voxel_indices` is `NULL`. Default `0`.

tr

Optional positive scalar repetition time in seconds. If `NULL`, inferred from 4D NIfTI headers (`pixdim[5]`, converting `msec`/`usec` units to seconds) when positive and consistent across runs.

run_names

Optional character vector of unique run names matching `length(niftis)`. Overrides `names(niftis)`. Defaults to `"run1"`, `"run2"`, etc. when `niftis` is unnamed.

voxel_ids

Optional character vector of unique voxel identifiers of length equal to the selected voxel count.

id_style

Naming convention when `voxel_ids` is `NULL`: `"ijk"` (default, 1-based `"i_j_k"` grid coordinates) or `"vnum"` (`"v1"`, `"v2"`, ...).

orientation

Matrix orientation: `"time_by_voxel"` (default, `T x V` matching all MEDuSA solvers) or `"voxel_by_time"` (`V x T`).

drop

Logical; if `TRUE` and `length(niftis) == 1L`, returns the single extracted matrix directly with `voxel_map`, `parcel_ids`, `tr`, and `geometry` attached as attributes. Default `FALSE`.

ncpus

Integer number of parallel worker processes used when extracting multiple NIfTI runs (`length(niftis) > 1L`). Default `1L`.

Value

By default (`drop = FALSE`), an S3 list of class `"medusa_nifti_ts"` with elements:

  • `bold`: Named list of numeric matrices (`T x V` by default) with voxel IDs on the voxel dimension.

  • `voxel_map`: `data.frame` with columns `voxel`, `vnum`, `linear_index`, `i`, `j`, `k`, `x`, `y`, `z`, and optional `mask_value` and `atlas_value`.

  • `parcel_ids`: Named vector mapping `voxel` IDs to `atlas_value` when `atlas` is supplied (`NULL` otherwise), directly usable as `spatial_groups` or `parcel_groups`.

  • `tr`: Scalar repetition time in seconds (`NA_real_` if unavailable).

  • `geometry`: Spatial geometry metadata list (`dim`, `spacing`, `units`, `affine`, `reference_file`).

  • `orientation`: Selected matrix orientation string.

  • `run_info`: `data.frame` summarizing `run`, `file`, `n_time`, and `header_tr`.

See also

[write_nifti_ts()], [align_medusa_ts()], [estimate_crossrun_hrf()], [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], [decon_epoch_regression()]

Examples

img <- array(rnorm(4 * 4 * 2 * 10), dim = c(4, 4, 2, 10))
mask <- array(0L, dim = c(4, 4, 2))
mask[1:2, 1:2, 1] <- 1L
f_img <- tempfile(fileext = ".nii.gz")
f_mask <- tempfile(fileext = ".nii.gz")
RNifti::writeNifti(img, f_img)
RNifti::writeNifti(mask, f_mask)

ts <- read_nifti_ts(c(run1 = f_img), mask = f_mask, tr = 1.0)
dim(ts$bold$run1)
#> [1] 10  4
head(ts$voxel_map)
#>   voxel vnum linear_index i j k x y z mask_value
#> 1 1_1_1    1            1 1 1 1 0 0 0          1
#> 2 2_1_1    2            2 2 1 1 1 0 0          1
#> 3 1_2_1    3            5 1 2 1 0 1 0          1
#> 4 2_2_1    4            6 2 2 1 1 1 0          1
unlink(c(f_img, f_mask))
